consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: corrective action following learning team review at P-4102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on P-4102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-4102 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 20 December 2025 a corrective action on P-4102 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
